issue.title: library: Cancel while an MCP server's sign-in is opening is undone when the start answers (mcp-oauth-app red under load)
issue.body:
Found while running the GUI files for #3492. mcp-oauth-app.test.cjs is red now and then in Chromium under load, on the step where "Save and sign in" is followed by the box's Cancel: the save and the start were called, but no cancel.

```
  [
    'save github {"clientId":"Ov23liAbCdEfGhIjKlMn",...,"callbackPort":3118}',
    'start github Ov23liAbCdEfGhIjKlMn',
-   'cancel'
  ]
```

On f8cd964a, alone, at load 31 to 53: red 1 of 12 runs (zh-TW 1100). With #3492's patch, which doesn't touch the library: red 2 of 6, and de 390 once in a run of 214 GUI files at load about 45.

The box's Cancel (signInBox in plugins/library/client.js) calls library/mcp-signin/<id>/cancel only when the sign-in has an id, and it gets one when the start answers. Pressed while the box still says "Opening the sign-in…", it sends nothing and draws "Sign in". When the start answers, start() sets mcpSigning from the answer without checking that it was canceled (it checks that only for a cancel during the save before it), so the box goes back to "Finish signing in in your browser…" and the sign-in is followed. The test meets this when its click lands before the start's answer, which load makes likelier.

A probe on f8cd964a's assets, not in any patch (the server's own OAuth app saved, "Sign in" pressed, the start's answer held, Cancel pressed while it is opening, then the answer let go), the same in Chromium and WebKit:
- after Cancel: the box says "Sign in"; called: the start
- 1.5s after the start answered: the box says "Finish signing in in your browser… Cancel"; called: the start, then a poll of the sign-in; no cancel

Not tried: a real server's sign-in, and whether the app opens the browser for the canceled one.

comments.body:
A fix is on [the fork branch](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3984-cancel-pending-mcp-signin), commit [8e4b41570](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/8e4b41570408f34b6ae254043757468e8c137e31), based on `ed0ab567`.

Each sign-in start has its own identity. If it is canceled before its ID arrives, the returned ID is canceled when it arrives; it cannot resume the old wait or overwrite a newer attempt. Cancellation after an ID is known still cancels it. Desktop opening is moved after the current-attempt check, since the old start handler opened the browser before returning.

**API change:** `POST /api/library/mcp-signin` now returns the authorization URL without opening it; direct API callers must open it themselves. The Library UI opens it via `/api/open` on desktop and in the browser in web mode, preserving the manual link and error if desktop opening fails. Existing external callers were not enumerated.

The real handler regression fails on the base and passes under `-race`. On the final built web page in Brave, an explicitly held start, cancel and second start keep the second waiting and cancel the old ID once; the second can then be canceled normally. A simulated desktop open failure shows the error and link; a native desktop success was not tested. The added Playwright test was syntax checked but not run because Playwright is unavailable; full `nogui` build and related vet pass. No real OAuth provider or full suite was tested. AI-assisted implementation and review.
